summary: This video tells the classic story of the Little Mermaid, who dreams of the human world and falls in love with a prince. After a magical deal with a witch and an exciting adventure, she finally finds true love and happiness.

phrases.pron: hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐ qián
phrases.usage: Use this classic phrase at the very beginning when you want to start telling a fairy tale or story to your friends.
phrases.example: 很久很久以前有一只小猫。
phrases.example_pron: hěn jiǔ hěn jiǔ yǐ qián yǒu yì zhī xiǎo māo.
phrases.example_en: Once upon a time, there was a little cat.

phrases.usage: Use this when talking about someone's age, especially when they are growing up or having a birthday.
phrases.example_pron: wǒ gē ge jīn nián shí bā suì.
phrases.example_en: My older brother is 18 years old this year.

phrases.usage: Use this polite phrase when you want to reassure your parents or teachers that everything will be okay and they don't need to worry.
phrases.example_pron: mā ma qǐng nín fàng xīn ba.

phrases.usage: Use this cheerful expression when someone asks you a question and you want to say 'yes, absolutely!'
phrases.example_pron: dāng rán le, wǒ hěn xǐ huan chī.
phrases.example_en: Of course, I like eating it very much.

phrases.usage: Use this warm greeting whenever it is someone's birthday to wish them a wonderful day.
phrases.example_pron: zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè!

phrases.usage: Use this when you are in a rush to do something quickly, like getting ready for school.
phrases.example_pron: wǒ yào gǎn jǐn qù shàng xué.
phrases.example_en: I need to hurry to go to school.

phrases.quote: 可是我真的很想再见到王子
phrases.usage: Use this when you want to express a strong wish or desire to do something or see someone.
phrases.example_pron: wǒ hěn xiǎng chī bīng qí lín.
phrases.example_en: I really want to eat ice cream.

phrases.quote: 可是现在的她无法发出任何声音
phrases.usage: Use this when something prevents you from doing an action, like not being able to speak or move.
phrases.example_pron: wǒ jīn tiān wú fǎ qù gōng yuán.
phrases.example_en: I am unable to go to the park today.

phrases.usage: Use this when you happily agree to do something or accept an invitation from a friend.
phrases.example_pron: wǒ yuàn yì hé nǐ wán.
phrases.example_en: I am willing to play with you.
